providerInventory.method: Official PDS account.sqlite token table; node:sqlite readOnly transaction
providerInventory.scope: Current active token rows for the canonical acceptance client and two owned DIDs. authorized_client consent metadata is independent and is not required to be absent. This check does not prove an earlier revocation HTTP response.

screenshots.method: Before each full-page render, the browser invoked the computed-color predicate, confirmed actual theme/color-scheme, body and visible muted/action colors, and waited for running CSS transitions to end. Each render also passed the one-pixel document-overflow bound.
screenshots.reason: An independent agent personally inspected 20 current representative screenshots and found no actionable defect. It did not inspect all180 images.

representativeReview.finding: No actionable defect. Small tonal split buttons, local errors and native/IndieWeb/manual sharing button actions remain contained. Light metadata colors match the theme.

161.criteria: Actual subscription/recommendation create/read/undo, retries/concurrency, second-client matching records, verified-target rejection and provider failure checks passed.

preCookieRecovery.scope: Separate actual probe on clean runtime3120; not executed by this social-only run.

limitations: No natural token-expiry wait occurred. Provider refresh was forced through the supported client in two isolated processes.
Authorization-state and browser-session expiry used exact isolated database deadline changes, not a real-time wait.
The genuine owned-PDS outage returned502 but the publisher and visitors share that provider. This does not independently locate the failure at visitor graph writes.
The provider inventory proves current canonical-client token absence. It does not prove the earlier SDK revocation HTTP response.

The provider baseline comparison preserved an empty foreign-token inventory. It does not demonstrate preservation of populated unrelated-client grants. authorized_client consent metadata is independent.
The fixture is a journaled dirty overlay on Git/runtime base4d, not a committed fixture. The local verifier source hashes are recorded separately and do not claim new deployed code.
All180 current full-page captures passed the corrected invoked color/transition and overflow gates. A separate representative20-image review passed; the reviewer did not inspect every image.
This run did not verify hosted Atmosphere response formats/cache refresh or simultaneous Atmosphere and IndieWeb responses on one writing.
Publishing lifecycles, independent validation, final notification workflow, fixture/alias removal and production rollout require their own receipts.

supplementalVerifierSourceHashes.method: Read-only source hash after terminal receipts; this child-script hash was not included in the capture startup source-hash map.
